def solve(inputs: dict) -> float:
    n = inputs.get('n', 146)
    k = inputs.get('k', 4)
    
    # Create list of people (1-indexed)
    people = list(range(1, n + 1))
    current_index = 0
    
    # Keep eliminating every k-th person until one remains
    while len(people) > 1:
        # Calculate the index of the person to eliminate
        # We move k positions forward (k-1 because we're 0-indexed)
        current_index = (current_index + k - 1) % len(people)
        # Remove the person at this index
        people.pop(current_index)
        # Adjust index: if we removed the last person, wrap to 0
        # Otherwise, the index already points to the next person
        if current_index >= len(people) and len(people) > 0:
            current_index = 0
    
    return float(people[0])
